title: Anna Karenina
author: Leo Tolstoy
summary: Moscow aristocrat Anna Karenina begins an affair with the dashing Count Vronsky and faces the cost. Alongside her story, the landowner Levin searches for meaning and happiness in country life.
readIf: you want a large, humane novel about love, marriage and society that rewards long reading.
skipIf: you dislike long digressions on farming and politics, or sad endings.

pairings.reason: Another classic about a married woman whose search for passion ends badly, with a sharper focus.
The same author's wider, more hopeful epic of Russia during the Napoleonic wars.
A shorter novel of love, status and tragedy.
